summary: Round-2 blocker is fixed and the FR surface largely conforms, but the run's own state.json carries a hand-written off-vocabulary 'halted' history event the delivered validator refuses, and the FR-015 personal-model-override pipeline never applies at install time while the installer's report misreports it.

findings.summary: The run's own state carries a hand-edited off-vocabulary 'halted' history event, failing the change's own validation (FR-001, FR-003, SC-001).
findings.evidence: Commit 79e0bf9 hand-writes the entry; `factory validate 007-stabilise-factory` exits 1 with history[11].event 'halted' is off-vocabulary.
findings.fix: Rewrite history[11] to the conformant representation (status/halt_reason plus the 'halt' timeline entry) or deliberately extend the vocabulary in state.md, data-model.md and HISTORY_EVENTS together.

findings.summary: FR-015 diverges: personal model overrides in ${FACTORY_HOME:-~/.factory}/config.json never reach the installed agents or the installer's effective-model report.
findings.evidence: render.py:43-47 merges only when FACTORY_HOME is exported (test_render_models.py:122-141 asserts default home ignored); install.sh passes nothing. README.md:29 and DESIGN.md:199 promise otherwise; render.py:44 comment contradicts code. T024's picks silently stop applying.
findings.fix: Have install.sh report effective models by reading the user's factory home without re-rendering the linked dist, correct the comment, add an install-seam assertion.
